title: Harry Styles collapses on stage after choking on water
summary: Singer Harry Styles briefly collapsed on stage at London's Wembley Stadium during a live concert. The incident occurred after he reportedly choked on water while performing. He was able to recover and continue his performance.
summary_points: Harry Styles collapsed on stage at Wembley Stadium.
The collapse happened after he choked on water.
The incident occurred during a live concert.
Styles reportedly recovered and continued his performance.
